title: Rice Bowl Bar Night
seoTitle: Rice Bowl Bar Night | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Build-your-own grain bowls with proteins and toppings for ten
subtitle: Build-your-own grain bowls with proteins and toppings for ten
description: Steamed rice anchors a build bar with teriyaki chicken, roasted vegetables, edamame, pickled ginger, and sauces. Crew assembles bowls to taste—extra protein, light on sauce, or loaded with crunch.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.instruction: Rinse jasmine rice and cook with 4.5 cups water in a rice cooker or covered pot until fluffy. Fluff with a fork and hold covered with a damp towel until service.

steps.title: Prepare teriyaki chicken
steps.instruction: Season thighs with salt and pepper. Bake at 425°F for 22–25 minutes until internal temp reaches 175°F. Glaze with teriyaki during last 5 minutes, then slice. Target oven/smoker temperature: 425°F.

steps.title: Roast vegetables
steps.instruction: Toss broccoli and carrots with oil and salt. Roast at 425°F on sheet pans 18–20 minutes until tender and lightly charred at the edges. Target oven/smoker temperature: 425°F.

steps.title: Prep the bowl bar
steps.instruction: Arrange rice, sliced chicken, roasted veg, edamame, pickled ginger, sesame seeds, sriracha mayo, and soy sauce in labeled hotel pans along the line.

steps.title: Service and guide builds
steps.instruction: Suggest a base build: rice, chicken, veg, edamame, sauce, sesame. Let crew customize from there while you replenish hot components from backup pans.

proTips: Mix a little rice vinegar into the rice after cooking for subtle sushi-bar brightness.
Soft-boil eggs as an optional topping—runny yolk doubles as sauce.
Keep sriracha mayo cold until the line opens so it stays stable on hot rice.
tonightSpread: Full rice bowl bar with teriyaki chicken, roasted veg, and sauce station.
Miso soup in a thermos for crews wanting something warm to sip alongside bowls.
leftovers: Fry rice with leftover components and scrambled eggs for breakfast.
Pack bowls in containers for members heading out on early shift.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Rice bowls balance indulgence and nutrition without preaching. The bar format handles dietary preferences naturally and portions scale easily when extra members show up.
mealPrepNotes: Cook rice in a rice cooker and hold on warm. Roast vegetables on sheet pans ahead. Teriyaki chicken can be grilled or baked and sliced before service.
